decisions.reason: After several years the product likely meets at least a minimal aspiration level and the firm still has some slack, but overlap with another price-comparison tracking plugin keeps the risk of later consolidation material.

Its close fit with the firm's established optimization capabilities supports retention under satisficing behavior, though duplication within the price-comparison tracking area still creates a meaningful chance of withdrawal.

This reporting plugin remains closely aligned with the firm's core analytics and shop-optimization business, so without clear evidence of performance below aspiration management would more likely continue it than redeploy the resources.
